newsitem.title: USA: Palmer Wireless sees lower Q4 cash flow.
newsitem.headline: Palmer Wireless sees lower Q4 cash flow.

text.p: Palmer Wireless Inc said Thursday it expected net subscriber additions and operating cash flow for the fourth quarter, ended December 31, to be lower than current analyst estimates.
The company said increased competitive pricing of cellular services within its existing markets had obliged it to lower its expectations for the quarter.
It said net subscriber growth would likely range between 13,000 to 17,000 with full-year net internal subscriber gains in the range of 56,000 to 60,000.
The company said it expected to end 1996 with a total subscriber base in the range of 274,000 to 278,000 customers, a 29-percent to 31-percent increase from year-end 1995.

It said it would probably report operating cash flow for the fourth quarter in the range of $16.0 million to $17.0 million. For the full year ended December 31, 1996, operating cash flow would be between $66.0 million and $67.0 million, a 59-percent to 61-percent increase as compared to 1995, it said.
